Flanking.Label: Flanking
Flanking.Tooltip: +2 to attack rolls when flanking the target.

Prone.Label: Prone
Prone.Tooltip: -4 to melee attack rolls, +4 against you in melee.

Squeezing.Label: Squeezing
Squeezing.Tooltip: -4 to attack rolls while squeezing through a tight space.

HighGround.Label: High Ground
HighGround.Tooltip: +1 to melee attack rolls from higher elevation.

Charge.Label: Charge
Charge.Tooltip: +2 to the attack roll, -2 AC until your next turn.

DefensiveFighting.Label: Fight Defensively
DefensiveFighting.Tooltip: -4 to the attack roll, +2 AC until your next turn.

Proficient.Label: Proficient
Proficient.Tooltip: Uncheck if not proficient with this weapon (-4 to the attack roll).

NonLethal.Label: Non-lethal
NonLethal.Tooltip: Deal subdual damage instead of normal damage.

WieldMode.Label: Wield Mode
WieldMode.MismatchNotInMainHand: Attacked with the primary hand, but this weapon isn't equipped there.
WieldMode.MismatchNotInOffHand: Attacked with the off-hand, but this weapon isn't equipped there.
WieldMode.MismatchOffHandOccupied: Attacked two-handed, but the off-hand is holding something else.
WieldMode.InsufficientBab: Attacked with no Base Attack Bonus remaining in that hand.

COMBAT.NoActionAvailable: No action available for this attack.
COMBAT.ChargeMeleeOnly: A charge permits only a single melee attack.
